# A-1 Drain Cleaning

> A-1 Drain Cleaning is a locally based drain and sewer cleaning business in Mason City, Iowa. The company clears clogged household drains, main drain blockages, sewer line restrictions, floor drain backups, and other wastewater drainage problems in Mason City and nearby North Iowa communities. Call 641-530-2728. Service is available 24/7.

A-1 Drain Cleaning is based at 206 29th St SW, Mason City, IA 50401. Mason City is the primary market and home base for the surrounding North Iowa service area. The business provides residential drain and sewer cleaning, not general plumbing for every type of plumbing repair.

When a homeowner describes a drain problem, the affected fixture and what happens when other fixtures are used can help identify the likely part of the drainage system involved. One slow sink may be a fixture or branch-drain clog. Several fixtures backing up together, wastewater coming up through a basement floor drain, or a tub filling when a toilet is flushed can point to a shared drain or main sewer restriction. The exact cause and location require assessment at the property.

A floor drain is often the lowest place where a downstream blockage becomes visible. If the basement floor drain backs up when a washing machine empties, the washer may be revealing a restriction farther down a shared drain line; it does not automatically mean the floor drain itself is clogged. In homes without basements, a main-line backup may show up in a bathtub or shower.

A-1 Drain Cleaning serves Mason City and nearby North Iowa communities. Service is also available in Albert Lea, Minnesota; the business is based in Mason City and does not operate a separate Minnesota office.

## Drain and Sewer Services

- [Drain Cleaning](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/drain-cleaning/): Cleaning clogged household drains and restoring drainage.
- [Emergency Drain Cleaning](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/emergency-drain-cleaning/): Urgent clogs affecting a toilet, sink, tub, shower, laundry drain, or floor drain.
- [Main Drain Cleaning](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/main-drain-cleaning/): Main house-drain blockages, especially when more than one fixture is affected.
- [Sewer Line Cleaning](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/sewer-line-cleaning/): Blockages and restrictions in the sewer line carrying wastewater away from the property.
- [Basement Floor Drain Backups](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/basement-floor-drains/): Water or sewage rising through a basement floor drain, including backups that happen when laundry drains.
- [Laundry and Washing Machine Drains](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/laundry-drains/): Washer standpipe and laundry drain backups, overflows, and downstream restrictions exposed by washer discharge.
- [Sewer Backup Emergency Service](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/sewer-backup-emergency/): Active wastewater backups involving floor drains or other low fixtures.
- [Sewer Backups into a Tub or Shower](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/sewer-backup-into-tub-shower/): Main-line backup symptoms in homes where wastewater appears in a bathtub or shower.
- [Tree Roots in Sewer Lines](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/tree-roots-in-sewer-line/): Sewer restrictions and recurring blockages caused by root growth.
- [Hydro Jetting](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/hydro-jetting/): Water-jet cleaning for suitable lines and buildup when the pipe condition and blockage make it appropriate.
- [Kitchen Drains](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/kitchen-drains/): Slow or clogged kitchen sinks and related kitchen drain problems.
- [Bathroom, Shower, and Tub Drains](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/bathroom-shower-drains/): Clogged or slow bathroom sinks, bathtubs, and showers.
- [Toilet Clogs](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/toilet-clogs/): Toilet clogs and toilet drainage problems; multiple affected fixtures can indicate a larger drain restriction.
- [Smoke Testing](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/smoke-testing/): Smoke testing as a method of investigating certain drain, sewer, or vent concerns.
- [Drain and Sewer Camera Inspections](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/sewer-camera-inspection/): Camera inspection of an accessible line when a blockage keeps returning or pipe condition needs to be checked.
- [Sewer Line Locating](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/services/sewer-line-locating/): Locating an underground drain or sewer line route or point of interest when access and conditions allow.
- [Drain and Sewer Pipe Repair](https://a1draincleaning.github.io/pipe-repair/): Pipe repair when a damaged or failing line cannot be corrected by cleaning alone.
